crossRefs.note: “Lord Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven…
For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
“The house which I am building will be great; for our God is greater than all gods.
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
For Yahweh is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
“Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my…
I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Let it be known to you: be ashamed and confounded for your ways…
Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.
“See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who…
There is no one as holy as Yahweh, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.
There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
“To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
I am Yahweh, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,

“Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.

translations.web: Therefore you are great, Yahweh God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
translations.bsb: How great You are, O Lord GOD! For there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
translations.kjv: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
translations.asv: Wherefore thou art great, O Jehovah God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God besides thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
